title: Concertino project config
description: Per-project configuration that parameterizes the Concertino agent orchestra. `concertino sync` renders the harness-specific files from core/ + this config.

harnesses.description: Which harness adapters to render on sync.

name.description: Human label used in agent prose.

baseBranch.description: Branch PRs target and diffs compare against.

idExample.description: Sample ticket id, e.g. HEL-26, used in rendered examples.

teamKey.description: Linear team key the launch pad fetches tickets for, e.g. CON. Distinct from idExample, which is only a sample id for agent prose and is often a placeholder. Falls back to the idExample prefix when unset; LINEAR_TEAM_KEY overrides both.

changeDir.description: Change directory template; <CHANGE_NAME> is filled at runtime.

scaffoldCmd.description: Command to scaffold a new change (<CHANGE_NAME> substituted at runtime).

envFiles.description: Uncommitted files copied into each worktree (e.g. backend/.env).

linkModules.description: Module directories (relative to repo root, e.g. frontend/node_modules) to populate in each worktree so pre-commit hooks that need installed deps can run without `git commit -n`. Rendered as CONCERTINO_LINK_MODULES. Each dir is hardlink-copied (cp -al) from the main checkout when the lockfile at dirname(dir)/package-lock.json matches, else `npm ci` is run in dirname(dir). The lockfile is assumed at dirname(dir)/package-lock.json.

hooks.description: Commands run inside the worktree after creation (e.g. npx husky install).

devServers.description: Backend/frontend dev-server commands. Omit a side that doesn't exist.

gates.description: Verification gates. Each runs only when changed files match `when`.

when.description: Glob matched against changed files, or 'always'.

canonicalDocs.description: Project standards agents are bound to read just-in-time.

when.description: 'always' or a glob; binding only applies when changed files match.

dashboard.description: Settings for `concertino watch`, the fleet dashboard. Distinct from `ui`, which describes whether the project under test has a user interface.

tmuxSession.description: tmux session name holding one window per run.

launchCommand.description: Command `n` runs in a new tmux window. `{{TICKET}}` is substituted with the ticket id. Defaults from the configured harness: `claude "/concertino-deliver {{TICKET}}"`, or `codex "..."` for a codex-only project.

maxConcurrent.description: Cap on simultaneously running orchestrators launched from the launch pad's queue runner (lib/ui/queue.js). Sequential batches use maxConcurrent 1 — the same code path, not a separate one. Editable per-batch on the launch plan screen ('c'); this is only the default.

escalationTimeoutMinutes.description: How long `emit-event.sh --await` blocks before giving up and letting the agent fall back to presenting the escalation in chat. Rendered into CONCERTINO_ESCALATION_TIMEOUT_MIN in .concertino.env by `concertino sync`. The orchestrator invokes --await inside a single harness command call, which has its own outer timeout (Claude Code caps a Bash call at ~10 minutes) — keep this comfortably under that, or the harness kills the wait before --await's own timeout can fire and log escalation.timeout cleanly.

enabled.description: Enables the ticket-provider launch pad, reached from `concertino watch`'s fleet view on 'N'. Read by lib/ui/linear.js launchPadStatus(), which additionally requires ticketProvider.kind=linear and a non-empty LINEAR_API_KEY — 'N' is always bound and explains whichever of the three is missing rather than doing nothing.

models.description: Model overrides per role. Accepts Claude Code model aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku) or full model IDs. All roles default to sonnet.

orchestrator.description: Claude Code model alias — e.g. sonnet

executor.description: Claude Code model alias — e.g. sonnet

evaluator.description: Claude Code model alias — e.g. haiku (re-runs gates mechanically, cheaper is fine)

skeptic.description: Claude Code model alias — e.g. opus (subjective design judgment; benefits from a stronger model)

codex.description: OpenAI model ID for the Codex harness — e.g. codex-mini-latest, o4-mini, gpt-4.1
